shadows.name: fab-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary FAB elevation only; prefer hairline borders elsewhere.

shadows.name: segment-selected
shadows.purpose: Legacy segment lift; prefer theme SegmentedButton without custom shadow.

motion.name: duration-short
motion.purpose: Filter chips, segmented control, short UI transitions.

motion.name: reduce
motion.purpose: When MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf is true via MintMotion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Mint fill CTA with navy label — primary actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2CE683; color: #05122B; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), opacity 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #24C974; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #05122B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1EA35D; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #B8F5D4; color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.6); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #2CE683; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #2CE683; border-radius: 16px; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), color 0.18s; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: #E8FBF2; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #24C974; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outlined:active { background: #B8F5D4; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: mintInputDecoration: filled white/card, mint focus ring 1.5px, always labelText.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.6); } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #05122B; border: 1.5px solid rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.3); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.22); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #2CE683; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #E05A40; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: 48dp min height; selected mint fill + navy label; idle brand overlay on navy chrome.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 247, 251, 0.22); background: rgba(244, 247, 251, 0.12); color: #F4F7FB; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), color 0.18s; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background: #2CE683; border-color: #2CE683; color: #05122B; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2CE683; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat card surface + 1px hairline; lg radius; internal padding ≥16.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #05122B; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.6); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Material NavigationBar with mint-wash indicator; theme-driven.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 68px; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.1); font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border: none; background: transparent; color: rgba(5, 18, 43, 0.3); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { color: #24C974; font-weight: 600; background: #E8FBF2; border-radius: 16px; margin: 8px 6px; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2CE683; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-nav-icon { display: flex; }

components.name: FAB
components.description: End-float add-transaction FAB; mint fill, navy icon, lg radius.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add transaction"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 13h-6v6h-2v-6H5v-2h6V5h2v6h6v2z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 56px; height: 56px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; background: #2CE683; color: #05122B; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(44, 230, 131, 0.3); transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #24C974; } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #05122B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-fab:active { background: #1EA35D; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(44, 230, 131, 0.25); }

components.name: Budget Ring
components.description: Signature Home control: navy field, mint progress arc, Poppins amount.
components.html: $1,240of $3,500 spent
components.css: .ds-ring { position: relative; width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%; background: #05122B; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-ring-track { position: absolute; inset: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 10px solid rgba(244, 247, 251, 0.12); } .ds-ring-progress { position: absolute; inset: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 10px solid transparent; border-top-color: #2CE683; border-right-color: #2CE683; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-ring-center { position: relative; text-align: center; color: #F4F7FB; } .ds-ring-amount { display: block; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.3px; line-height: 1; } .ds-ring-caption { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(244, 247, 251, 0.55); }

narrative.overview:
Mintflow is an Operate-mode personal finance app. The UI should feel like a clear monthly ledger under cool daylight: navy brand chrome for authority, mint for progress and primary action, cream paper for reading. Density stays scannable — one primary task per screen, amounts in Poppins, UI chrome in DM Sans.

Brand expresses through palette, type pairing, and the budget ring — not through glassmorphism, purple glow, or dashboard-stat clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Navy headers / mint CTAs / cream canvases
Material 3 scaffolding with Mintflow tokens (not Dynamic Color by default — brand-first static schemes)
Light and dark are first-class ThemeData schemes
Adaptive shell: bottom bar < 840dp, navigation rail ≥ 840dp
Motion is ease-out only; honor Reduce Motion / disable animations

rules.name: The Mint Rarity Rule
rules.body: Mint owns primary actions and progress. Do not flood screens with mint fills.

rules.name: The Brand Overlay Rule
rules.body: On navy chrome, use onBrand / brandOverlay — never raw gray or ad-hoc white opacities for new work.

rules.name: The Dynamic Color Rule
rules.body: Android wallpaper-derived schemes are intentionally out of scope; keep the static navy/mint brand unless product revisits this.

rules.name: The Eleven Point Floor
rules.body: No UI text below 11px. Decorative glyphs may be icon-sized, not type-sized under the floor.

dos: Do use MintflowColors.* helpers (page, card, textPrimary, onBrand, washes) instead of raw hex in screens.
Do keep touch targets ≥48dp and add tooltips/semantics on icon-only controls.
Do gate decorative motion with MintMotion / MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf.
donts: Don't introduce purple-on-white marketing gradients or gold accents (legacy token names map to mint).
Don't lock portrait to hide layout bugs; adapt with breakpoints.
Don't ship unlabeled GestureDetector icon hits or visual-only Label without labelText.
Don't drop type below 11px for badges — use MintflowTextStyles.chip.
